refunds.txt: Unused products can be returned for a refund within 14 days of purchase. Used products require manual approval and are not automatically eligible.
shipping.txt: Standard shipping takes three to five business days. Express shipping takes one to two business days.
security.txt: For a password reset open Account Settings, select Security, and choose Reset password. A recovery email is required.
privacy.txt: Customer account deletion requests can be filed in Privacy Settings. The service completes deletion within thirty calendar days.
billing.txt: The monthly invoice is issued on the first business day of each month. Invoice disputes must be reported within ten calendar days.
warranty.txt: The product warranty covers manufacturing defects for twenty-four months. Accidental water damage is not covered.
support.txt: Customer support operates Monday through Friday from nine to seventeen UTC. Urgent incidents must use the emergency hotline.
retention.txt: Meeting audio is retained for ninety days. Transcripts are retained for one hundred eighty days unless a legal hold applies.
incident.txt: Security incidents rated severity one require acknowledgment within fifteen minutes and escalation to the incident commander.
access.txt: Access to confidential recordings requires an explicit read grant. A revoked grant takes effect on the next search query.
